scripts.clean: find . -name '.next' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -exec rm -rf {} + ; find . -name '.turbo' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -exec rm -rf {} + ; find . -name 'dist' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -exec rm -rf {} + ; echo 'Build caches cleared.'
scripts.fresh: pnpm clean && pnpm install && pnpm dev
